name: google-chat
title: Google Chat
description: Search spaces and direct messages, read and reply to messages, see your unread chats, and send messages in Google Chat.
author: smrehan

commands.name: search-spaces
commands.title: Search Spaces & DMs
commands.subtitle: Google Chat
commands.description: Search your spaces, group chats and direct messages, read their messages, and send or mark them as read.

commands.name: my-messages
commands.title: My Messages
commands.subtitle: Google Chat
commands.description: Your conversations, like Google Chat's Home: unread ones first with counts and mentions, then the rest by latest activity, each with the latest message from someone else. Switch to Unread only with the dropdown or ⌘U.

preferences.name: defaultView
preferences.title: Default View
preferences.description: What My Messages shows the first time you open it. Afterwards it remembers your last choice.

commands.name: unread-count
commands.title: Unread Chat
commands.subtitle: Google Chat
commands.description: Shows your unread Google Chat total in root search, checked every 5 minutes after you run it once. Running it opens the conversation when only one has unread messages, else My Messages' unread view.

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Send Message
commands.subtitle: Google Chat
commands.description: Send a message to a space, group chat, direct message, or anyone in your directory, optionally in a thread.

commands.name: quick-message
commands.title: Quick Message
commands.subtitle: Google Chat
commands.description: Send a message from root search to a person's email or a space name.

commands.name: find-person
commands.title: Find Person
commands.subtitle: Google Chat
commands.description: Search your organization's directory and open or send a direct message.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: Google OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: OAuth client ID of type iOS with bundle ID com.raycast, from a Google Cloud project with the Google Chat API (and People API) enabled and the Chat app configuration filled in.

preferences.name: openWith
preferences.title: Open With
preferences.description: Browser or app that opens Google Chat links. Empty uses your default browser.

preferences.name: unreadLookbackDays
preferences.title: Unread Lookback (Days)
preferences.description: Only unread messages from this many recent days are counted.
